name: ktx
title_zh: 给数据代理装上可检索的记忆层
tagline_zh: 当你的 agent 每次都要重新问一遍数据库结构，装上 ktx 它就记得住。一条命令装好，连 embedding 。
tagline_en: Tired of your agent re-discovering your schema every session? ktx gives it a persistent, searchable context layer.
desc_en: Installs and configures ktx, the open-source context layer for data agents — runs ktx setup non-interactively with hidden CLI flags, configures database connections and embeddings, installs agent integration, and verifies readiness. Use when the user asks an agent to add ktx to a project, connect data sources, install agent rules, ingest schema, or troubleshoot a local ktx install.
why_zh: 非交互式安装，用隐藏 CLI 旗标跑完 setup，自动配库连 embedding。
why_en: Non-interactive setup via hidden flags: configures DB + embeddings, installs agent rules, verifies readiness — fully scriptable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 ktx 的安装与配置，不负责后续数据质量。需要本地已有目标数据库和 embedding 服务。
limit_en: Only installs/configures ktx — no data curation. Requires an existing DB and embedding endpoint; schema ingestion is your job, not its.
